rawRecord.EXPERIMENTAL_ai_generated_description: Deskmate is a macOS automation tool that enables remote control of your Mac through natural language commands via Telegram bot or MCP server interfaces. It uses Claude Code's agent SDK to execute shell commands, read/write files, list directories, and retrieve system information. The implementation features built-in approval mechanisms for security, protected folder access controls, and a modular agent provider system that can be extended to other AI providers.
